bearings.rule: Envelope spectrum of the band with the highest kurtosis. For each defect rate (BPFO, BPFI, BSF, FTF) take harmonics 1 to 3; a harmonic stands out when the peak within +-1% (at least +-0.5 Hz) of the expected line, ignoring bins within 0.3 Hz of a shaft harmonic, is at least 6 dB above the median of the spectrum within 10 Hz. A defect is present when at least 2 of its 3 harmonics stand out; the diagnosis is the present defect with the highest mean peak level over its harmonics, or 'none' when no defect is present.

post_hoc_baseline_rule.rule: Shaft rate: the 1x vibration line within the motor's slip range (synchronous speed down to 10% slip), interpolated. Envelope spectra of the test recording and of the same bearing's healthy recording, both in the test recording's highest-kurtosis band. A defect series grew when at least 2 of its 3 harmonics both stand out in the test recording (at least 6 dB over local background) and rose at least 6 dB over the healthy recording; the diagnosis is the grown series with the largest mean rise, or 'none'.

sounds.score: root mean square of robust z-scores (median, 1.4826 MAD) against 60 normal clips
